# Dropdown Menu

> An animated dropdown menu for React and shadcn, with checkbox and radio rows, shortcuts and submenus.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/dropdown-menu?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/dropdown-menu/](../../src/registry/eased/dropdown-menu/)
- Installs: `components/eased/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.tsx`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/dropdown-menu
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/dropdown-menu.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

A list of commands that opens from a button, built on Base UI Menu, the Eased floating layer and the shared overlay-core rows.

## When to use

- A handful of actions on one object: a document's "⋯" menu, a row's actions, an account menu.
- View options that belong with those actions: a "Show completed" toggle, a "Sort by" choice.
- Actions that need a second level ("Move to" → projects) without leaving the menu.

## When not to use

- Picking a value for a form field: use Select, which shows the value in its trigger.
- The same actions on right click: add a [Context Menu](https://eased.dev/components/context-menu?ref=context7) as well, never instead.
- Rich content such as forms or people lists: use [Popover](https://eased.dev/components/popover?ref=context7).
- Searching hundreds of commands: use a Command palette.

## Usage

```tsx example.tsx
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/eased/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu";

export function DocumentMenu() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" aria-label="Document options">
        <MoreIcon />
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
        <DropdownMenuItem icon={<DuplicateIcon />} shortcut="⌘D" onClick={duplicate}>
          Duplicate
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem icon={<LinkIcon />} onClick={copyLink}>
          Copy link
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem icon={<TrashIcon />} shortcut="⌘⌫" tone="danger" onClick={trash}>
          Delete
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

## Examples

### Checkbox and radio rows

Toggles and one-of-many choices stay open on click so people can set several; the check draws into the icon track.

```tsx
<DropdownMenuCheckboxItem checked={showCompleted} onCheckedChange={setShowCompleted}>
  Show completed
</DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
<DropdownMenuSeparator />
<DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
  <DropdownMenuLabel>Sort by</DropdownMenuLabel>
  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="updated">Last updated</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="created">Date created</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="name">Name</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
</DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
```

### Submenu

The submenu opens beside its row, with its first row on the trigger row's line.

```tsx
<DropdownMenuSub>
  <DropdownMenuSubTrigger icon={<FolderIcon />}>Move to</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuSubContent>
    {projects.map((p) => (
      <DropdownMenuItem key={p.id} disabled={p.id === current} onClick={() => move(p.id)}>
        {p.name}
      </DropdownMenuItem>
    ))}
  </DropdownMenuSubContent>
</DropdownMenuSub>
```

### A disabled row that says why

Keep unavailable commands in place and say why on the row (rule 67), not in a tooltip.

```tsx
<DropdownMenuItem icon={<DownloadIcon />} description="On the Team plan" disabled>
  Export as PDF
</DropdownMenuItem>
```

## API reference

### DropdownMenu

Base UI `Menu.Root`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `modal` (true), `loopFocus`, `closeParentOnEsc`, `actionsRef` and the rest. It also provides the context rows use to blink before closing; your `actionsRef` still receives Base UI's `close` and `unmount`.

### DropdownMenuTrigger

Base UI `Menu.Trigger` props, rendered as an Eased `Button`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `"secondary"` | The Button variant; `"ghost"` for a quiet header "⋯". |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | `"sm"` | `"icon-sm"` for a square icon trigger. |
| `openOnHover` | `boolean` | | Also open on hover (100ms `delay`). |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | `300` with `openOnHover`, else `0` | Wait after the pointer leaves before closing (rule 71). |
| `render` | `ReactElement \| function` | | Your own trigger; style it with `floatingTrigger`. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Appended to the Button's classes. |

### DropdownMenuContent

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | `FloatingSide` | `"bottom"` | Flips on collision; the enter direction follows. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | `"start"` | |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `4` | Gap to the trigger, px. |
| `alignOffset` | `number` | `0` | |
| `finalFocus` | Base UI `finalFocus` | the trigger | Where focus goes on close. |
| `container` | `HTMLElement \| null` | `document.body` | Portal target. |
| `zIndex` | `number` | `50` | Raise it inside a dialog. |
| `width` | `string` | fits the rows, ≥ 192px | A CSS width, e.g. `"15rem"`. Never wider than the viewport. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Appended to the popup's classes. |

### DropdownMenuItem

Base UI `Menu.Item` props (`onClick`, `disabled`, `label`, …), plus:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | | 16px icon in the leading track. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | | Glyphs for the trailing column, e.g. `"⌘⇧C"`. Display only; bind the key yourself. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | | A second, muted line. |
| `tone` | `"default" \| "danger"` | `"default"` | `"danger"` for destructive actions: red label, red-tinted highlight. |
| `closeOnClick` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` keeps the menu open and skips the blink. |

`DropdownMenuLinkItem` takes the same content props on Base UI `Menu.LinkItem` (`href`); it doesn't blink, because the navigation is the feedback.

### DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem

Base UI `Menu.CheckboxItem` (`checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`), `Menu.RadioGroup` (`value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`) and `Menu.RadioItem` (`value`), with `shortcut` and `description`. The check takes the icon track.

### DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent

`DropdownMenuSub` is Base UI `Menu.SubmenuRoot`. `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` takes `icon` and `description` plus Base UI's `openOnHover` (true), `delay` (100) and `closeDelay` (0). `DropdownMenuSubContent` takes `width`, `container`, `zIndex` and `className`.

### DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator

A group of rows on the menu's tracks, its 12px muted heading, and a full-bleed 1px rule.

### useMenuFlash, MenuFlashContext

For building another root (Context Menu does): `useMenuFlash(actionsRef?)` returns `{ ref, flash }`; pass `ref` as Base UI's `actionsRef` and provide `flash` through `MenuFlashContext`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Enter` / `Space` / `ArrowDown` on the trigger | Opens the menu and highlights the first row. |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Moves the highlight; loops at the ends. |
| `Home` / `End` | First or last row. |
| A letter | Jumps to the next row starting with it. |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Chooses the row (toggles a checkbox or radio row). |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Opens a submenu / closes it and returns to its row. |
| `Escape` | Closes the current menu; focus returns to the trigger. |

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a `button` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`; give an icon-only trigger an `aria-label`.
- The popup is a `menu`; rows are `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` and `menuitemradio`, with `aria-checked` and `aria-disabled`. Group labels name their groups.
- Shortcuts are read by name ("Command Shift C"); icons and checks are hidden from assistive tech.
- Focus moves into the menu on open and back to the trigger on close (`finalFocus` to send it elsewhere, e.g. a rename field).
- Rows are 32px, 40px on coarse pointers. Disabled rows stay in arrow-key order so they can be read (Base UI), dimmed, and ignore clicks.

## Motion

The menu opens on mousedown from the trigger's transform-origin: 4px toward the trigger at 0.97, transform on the snappy spring, opacity over 150ms; it leaves half as far and scales half as much in 100ms on the standard curve, with no overshoot. Both are CSS transitions on Base UI's `data-starting-style` / `data-ending-style`, so a quick open-close reverses mid-flight. One highlight glides between rows on the snappy spring (each submenu has its own); rows never scale or change weight. Choosing a command blinks its highlight off for 40ms and on for 40ms, then the menu closes, as macOS does; checkbox and radio rows don't blink. A submenu slides 4px out from its row. Under reduced motion the menu only fades (100ms), the highlight jumps, and choosing closes at once.

## Notes for AI

Use `DropdownMenu` for commands on an object; put the trigger in the object's header as a ghost `size="icon-sm"` button with an `aria-label`, and `align="end"` the content when the trigger sits on the right edge. Give destructive rows `tone="danger"` and follow them with an undo or confirm step (rule 73). Use `description` on a disabled row to say why it is unavailable.

Don't wrap rows in your own buttons or add `onKeyDown` navigation: Base UI handles focus, typeahead and dismissal. Don't call `setOpen(false)` in an item's `onClick`; the row closes the menu itself after its blink. Shortcuts are labels only; register the key bindings in your app.

## Related

- [Context Menu](https://eased.dev/components/context-menu?ref=context7): the same rows, opened at the pointer by right click or long press.
- [Popover](https://eased.dev/components/popover?ref=context7): an anchored panel for content rather than commands.
